prompt: The billing module shipped last sprint. Can you do an architecture review on it and let me know if there are structural issues we should address before the codebase grows?
assertions: Identifies the fat controller / missing service layer anti-pattern
Notes that business logic (computing daysLeft, isActive, customer lookup) is embedded in route handlers
Flags direct Stripe API calls in route handlers instead of an application/infrastructure layer
Flags direct DB queries (db.select, db.update) in route handlers
Recommends extracting a BillingService (application layer) and/or BillingRepository (infrastructure layer)
Notes the missing composition root / dependency injection
